children: Nissan Motor and Honda Motor have agreed to jointly develop key systems and software that form the core of next-generation vehicles.

The Japanese automakers said Monday that they signed a joint development agreement and that both companies aim to adopt the architecture incorporating the jointly developed systems and software in their vehicles from the fiscal year starting in April 2029.
